title: B.Tech Admission Eligibility - UPTAC 2025-26

eligibility.entrance_exam: JEE Main 2025 for regular B.Tech counselling

verification_note: These criteria refer to the 2025-26 academic session. Do not present them as confirmed requirements for 2026-27.
text: According to the UPTAC Information Brochure 2025-26, B.Tech admission eligibility includes 10+2 qualification or an applicable D.Voc. pathway. Minimum marks are 45% in the specified subjects taken together, or 40% for SC/ST candidates. JEE Main 2025 was the primary entrance examination for regular B.Tech counselling. Detailed subject requirements should be checked against the applicable AICTE rules. These details apply to 2025-26 and are not verified for 2026-27.
